description: Defines reference counting classes and templates for QUIC, including QuicheReferenceCounted base class and QuicheReferenceCountedPointer smart pointer template.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCounted
classes.description: Base class for explicitly reference-counted objects in QUIC.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointer
classes.description: Template class for reference-counted smart pointers managing objects derived from QuicheReferenceCounted.

methods.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointer(T* p)
methods.description: Constructor from raw pointer, guarantees reference count of 1.

methods.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointer(std::nullptr_t)
methods.description: Constructor allowing implicit conversion from nullptr.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Member access operator for referenced object.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns raw pointer without changing reference count.
